messages:
Maya Patel: Draft PRD uploaded — tenant stickiness + progressive unpinning experiment. Link: https://redwood.app/drive/prd/tenant-stickiness
Maya Patel: Need ACs for safety, rollback criteria, and how we pin by model version + tenant.
Ajay Rao: skimmed — left comments on thresholds. Primary metric should be p99 latency + user-facing error rate.
Sophia Chen: also add "stale KV cache" edge case — when tenant cache invalidation lags for pinned models. Might require forced cache flush on rollbacks.
Luis Ortega: question — pin expiry: are we planning time-based expiry or traffic-based expiry? We need both.
Maya Patel: thinking time-based grace window (e.g., 24h) + idle-tenant eviction if no requests for X minutes.
Ajay Rao: for A/B: propose 3 cohorts: control (no pin), soft-pin (best-effort pin with fallback), hard-pin (strict routing to variant). Start 1%/5%/20% ramp.
Sophia Chen: acceptance criteria proposal: no more than 5% relative increase in median latency for pinned traffic; p99 degrade <=10% absolute; regression alert fires otherwise.
Luis Ortega: rollback heuristic: automatic rollback if SLA breach for > 2 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 0.5% for 5m.
Tamara (prod): concern — cost impact. We need estimate of additional GPU hours under hard-pin. Add budgeting line item in PRD.
Maya Patel: added cost section. Also added experiment runbook w/ manual abort steps and playbook:
```
abort: set traffic to control; clear pin map; revert model alias
postmortem: gather traces, sample prompts, run eval set
``` 
Ajay Rao: can we add tenant opt-out for enterprise customers? Legal asked for explicit opt-out control.
Maya Patel: yes — UX ticket to expose "pin control" for tenant admins.
DevEx Bot: PRD CI check passed — lint + schema validation OK :white_check_mark:
Sophia Chen: edge case: model variants with incompatible KV formats — need compatibility check during onboarding and automated canary to verify tokenization + logits parity.
Luis Ortega: experiment analysis plan: log shard: model_variant, tenant_id, route, latency_ms, tokens_out, error_flag — run daily diff with historical baseline.
Tamara (prod): add launch gate: must run internal canary for 48h with synthetic traffic and < 0.2% error.
Maya Patel: noted. I'll update PRD and send for final review by EOD tomorrow. If no objections we'll schedule canary next Tue.
Ajay Rao: +1
Sophia Chen: +1
Luis Ortega: +1
Tamara (prod): +1
Maya Patel: thanks all — filing follow-ups: UX-1123, COST-409, ENG-789
